blocks.text: AI (artificial intelligence) here means a program that learned from a huge amount of text and can now understand questions and write answers. Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini are programs like this, also called AI assistants.
When you send a message, the AI predicts which answer fits best, word by word. It doesn't look things up like an encyclopedia – it builds the answer from patterns it learned.
What it can do for you

items: Explain something complicated in simple words
Write or improve text: an email, a message, a CV
Make a plan: a trip, a workout, a busy week at work
Help you come up with ideas

blocks.text: AI sometimes makes mistakes while sounding confident. Always double-check important facts (health, money, law).
New tip: if an answer is too complicated, just write "Explain that more simply" – the AI will try again.
Explain to me, as a complete beginner, what artificial intelligence is, in 5 sentences.
